title: GANIZA Food Processors, Electric Chopper with Meat Grinder & Veggie Chopper - 2 Bowls with Powerful Copper Motor - Includes 2 Sets of Bi-Level Blades for Baby Food/Meat (Grey, 8 Cup+8 Cup)
description:
About this item
【Indispensable Kitchen Helper】GANIZA BPA FREE food processor features 2 sets of blades and paired bowls (8-Cup glass bowl and 8-Cup stainless steel bowl). Easily chop meat, fish, vegetables, nuts, frozen fruit, or make a salad, guacamole, etc, the food chopper is ideal for multiple kitchen tasks!
【Efficient Motor & Safety Insurance】The Full-copper motor supports a 3 times longer service life than regular motors. Adopting patented automatic stopping design to protect your family and child, and blades are spring-loaded and stop rotating immediately once you pop the motor out of the way.
【Please Note】Ganiza food processor is equipped with an overheating protection system. If the machine stops working, please wait a few minutes for the machine to cool down before starting it. Overheating protection system is built to ensure quality & lifetime, and also makes the food processor safe.
【Unlock Versatility with Two Bowls】Your food hygiene, we care. The Mixing Bowls are made from different materials (glass and sus 304 stainless steel) to avoid confusion between bowls for different uses, meat chopper and vegetable chopper, family processor and baby food processor.
【2 Speed - Great Time Saver】Powerful copper motor certified for professional use combined with upgraded two levels of "S" stainless steel blades, a few seconds is enough to turn any vegetable or meat into tiny bits. 2 cutting speeds to meet different needs of foods or texture.
【Make an Exhausting Job a Breeze】Still struggling about daily handling of onions or meats? Just an electric food chopper is all you need to make cooking fun. The GANIZA chops, mixes, blends, whips, grinds, and more, all with a simple push to start. Easy to clean with removable blades. Powerful veggie chopper made thanksgiving prep a breeze.

For the price, it offers great value and solid performance. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable, multifunctional chopper!This is a great lil appliance. reviews_1s:
I've had this food processor for just at a year now, and it used to work great! We've only used it a handful of times, mostly to grind up crackers or meat, and once with bones that had been softened after being processed four times for soups and stocks. All was well, but yesterday it died out of the blue. There's no damage to the cord or any pieces, and it was working fine to dice up stale bread (cut into small cubes), until it suddenly stopped. The motor didn't feel hot, but it hasn't been operable since. I tried looking for customer support options and troubleshooting, in case I missed something obvious, but all I could fine was a troubleshooting guide for a different electric meat grinder I assume the brand carries. So now I have two bowls and no way to process anything, even though I tried my best not to overwork it. I wish I could just exchange it for a new one, since this one might have had a small defect, but no luckWe were initially impressed by the product upon using it for the first time. However, after we cleaned the product, we realized the blades design has its flaws. Raw meat was stuck inside of the small hole, with a spring.Even if it looks like clean, it was hiding some raw meat. we used a small toothpick to push it, and more meat was coming out. Not ideal for meat, I think maybe veggies are fine since it’s less sticky and easier to soak it out.After the first use, pieces of meat got trapped inside the plastic housing around the blade. There's no way to disassemble or properly clean it, which makes thorough washing impossible. I tried hand washing, soaking, even putting it in the dishwasher— nothing helps. The design is awful, and it creates a serious hygiene issue. Food will rot inside after just 1 use. Extremely poor build quality-this product is both garbage and a potential health hazard. Avoid at all costs!I've been cooking in kitchens and restaurants for 50 years, and this might be the most poorly made, non-quality gadget I have ever come across. Gave it a whirl for chopping onion. Peeled and diced the onion to make it easier on the device. Loaded about half-way in the bucket (beneath the top blade. Well, I ended up with very fine shards of the blade in my chopped onions. I wasn't trying to chop anything out of the ordinary, just an ONION. Beware.

UPDATE: Seller reached out and offered a refund. I replied that would be fine, then put me into a hilarious loop of "are you sure"? Questions. I'll just take the loss on this complete waste of money, lesson learned and call it a day.This product stopped working the first day we received it. The motor became hot and it quit working. It was left unplugged for over 10 minutes and still felt hot to the touch. We tried waiting 30 minutes like the instructions said and it still wouldn't work. This motor is cheap and this product is not worth the money. I requested a refund and hopefully will find a better product from a different supplier.This company contacted me after I wrote the following review below offering me and asking me if I wanted a full refund. When I accepted their offer , they never issued the refund. The review I wrote read as : This machine looked good in theory BUT...
It has 2 interchangeable bowls, one metal one glass..
it has a rubber cover that the Motor snaps into to do the chopping.
The only problem is if youre trying to mix liquids, the rubber cover DOES NOT SNAP SECURELY ONTO the bowls to prevent spillage. The first time i used this i was making a beverage with water as the main component and since the cover does not snap securely onto the bowls, when i turned it on to begin mixing... the Water went all over the place. Not Well Made!I hope you could see this review before you buy it !!!!! A real buyer experience!!!!

I initially felt very happy and satisfied with this chopper when I used it for ground pork. However, by the third use, the blade became quite dull, and some parts of the meat weren't chopping as finely as before. While I expected some reduction in sharpness over time, it happened much sooner than anticipated.

The main issue occurred during the fourth use: the machine stopped working, and I noticed a burning smell. The safety button on the outlet activated, and despite unplugging the machine, the burning smell persisted. After researching online, I found many reviews mentioning similar problems with the machine burning out or malfunctioning after just a few uses or months.

Fortunately, I was able to get a full refund since I was still within the 30-day return policy. I hope my review helps remind others that this machine is prone to breaking easily and raises awareness about its safety concerns.I started making homemade raw food for my dog and I wanted to find a way to easily grind up the variety of meats without having to chop everything by hand.

I was so so excited that this little thing actually cuts meat!! AND it did it well! Atleast for 2 months.

At first, it cut the meat quickly and I was able to get it to my desired consistency easily. I was excited for warmer weather and was planning to use it for salads as well.

My only gripe with the product was that the bowl doesn’t seal well to the lid and sometimes I would have meat mush coming out the top. It was annoying but cleaning that before the next grind was wayyy easier than cutting/handling raw meat completely by hand. I could handle a little meat mush.

That is until the whole thing died on me after only 2 months. I used the Ganiza food processor on 3 occasions over 2 months and the last time the motor went out on me. It smelled like burning plastic and stopped working. My house runs on battery/solar power so atleast it didn’t fry my entire system.The food grinder only lasted about 4 weeks and the motor burned down during mixing ground beef and onions. The Ganiza food grinder has poor reliability. There are no vent holes on the motor which is one of the reason it heats up.

No returns are offered after 4 weeks. Guess I am stuck with a dead food grinder.No stars! Lord. This thing started to smoke and grind the second i turned it on!! I had to run and unplug it quick before it started a fire. Who knew chopping tomatoes would be so dangerous. Have thrown away as they said no worries on return. Please be careful with this one.
